in_pashto.name: شاہناز

in_pashto.long_meaning: شاہناز نوم د فارسۍ څخه اخیستل شوی دی او معنی یې د شهزادو کورنۍ ویاږه یا اوږده پوزه ده. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور کې د ښکلا او لویوالي په معنا کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Shahnaaz
in_english.meaning: Shahnaaz means royal nose or long nose, signifying beauty and pride
in_english.long_meaning: Shahnaaz is derived from Persian roots, meaning royal nose or long nose. It signifies beauty, pride, and nobility. In Islamic culture, the name Shahnaaz is used to denote someone with a regal and elegant presence. Etymologically, it relates to 'shah' meaning king and 'naz' meaning nose or pride. The name has historical significance in South Asian and Middle Eastern Muslim traditions.
